svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for Product Design. On a dotted floor, a long pale strip at the front holds a worked-out map: a start point, a square decision and two branches; the chosen route runs in lime to an end with a tick, and the other branch is dashed to a pale end. Behind it stands the product at three stages, one in front of the other: at the back its simplest form in plain light blocks, then a tidier light version with nothing yet chosen, and in front the finished solid-blue screen with a menu, a table of records with one row in lime and a detail panel with a lime button. All three keep the same menu, table and detail panel in the same places, so one product is transformed from back to front. Dashed lines rise from the start, the decision and the chosen end to the menu, the table and the detail panel they decided. Just behind the far end of the map a solid blue Tcules designer leans in, pointing at the start point.
